title: guardrails-train-test
description: Private train/test split for a 7-way guardrail classifier (A safe, B hate, C insults, D sexual, E violence, F misconduct, G prompt attack). Built by build_dataset.py from Aegis 2.0, WildGuardMix, OR-Bench, civil_comments, deepset, jackhhao, Gandalf (train) and prompt-injections-benchmark, OpenAI moderation eval, Aegis test, XSTest, JailbreakBench, deepset test (test).
